questions.q: Who gives the talk about design thinking?
o: Milovan Dekić, co-author of a book and head of the user research group at Nordeus
questions.e: In the video: "Milovan Dekić, koji će nam pričati o design thinkingu. Milovan je inače koautor knjige o ovome i vođa grupe za istraživanja korisnika pri Nordeusu." — Milovan Dekić, who will talk to us about design thinking. Milovan is, by the way, the co-author of a book on this and the head of the user research group at Nordeus.

questions.q: What does the IBM example show about prototyping?
o: IBM wrote the program right away
You can simulate the experience: while a typist typed in the corner, people thought speech recognition was working
questions.e: In the video: "daktilografkinja sedela sakrivena u ćošku, i ono što ovaj priča, ona je kucala. Dakle, niste razvijali softver, nego ste fejkovali to iskustvo." — a typist sat hidden in the corner, and whatever this person said, she typed. So you weren't developing software, you were faking the experience.

questions.q: What is empathy in design thinking?
o: Spend time with the people you're creating the product for, and understand them
questions.e: In the video: "ti ljudi koji će to da koriste — budite malo zajedno s njima. Vidite šta rade, kako rade... To je ideja empatije" — those people who will use it — be together with them a bit. See what they do, how they do it... That's the idea of empathy.

questions.q: What happened to Airbnb's business after talking to users?
questions.e: In the video: "nakon nekih promena, skočio biznis za 400%" — after some changes, the business jumped by 400%.

questions.q: What conclusion was drawn from the McDonald's milkshake example?
o: People needed a thicker milkshake so that it would last for a long commute
The strawberry flavor should be removed
questions.e: In the video: "Napravili su ga gušćim, da zapravo može duže da traje, ukoliko vam je put do posla duži" — they made it thicker, so that it can actually last longer if your trip to work is longer.

questions.q: What is the "five whys" method?
o: Ask the interviewee "why is this a problem" five times to understand the real problem
questions.e: In the video: "five whys, pet puta ih pitajte: zašto ti je to problem?" — five whys, ask them five times: why is this a problem for you?

questions.q: What did the Product Hunt example show?
o: The author created a simple mailing list on Twitter and checked whether there was demand — 150 people signed up instead of 100
The author gave up the idea
questions.e: In the video: "napravio običnu mejling listu i okačio na Tviter... Umesto sto, neka se prijavilo 150 ljudi" — he made an ordinary mailing list and posted it on Twitter... Instead of a hundred, say 150 people signed up.

questions.q: How did Nordeus test the game on real people?
o: They offered to play for a mug of beer by the fountain at Obilićev venac
With a closed group in the office
questions.e: In the video: "Je l' možeš da odvojiš 20 minuta za mene, i ja te častim pivom?... sedeli danima s ljudima na Obilićevom vencu" — can you spare 20 minutes for me, and I'll buy you a beer?... we sat for days with people at Obilićev venac.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Spremni ste za našeg sledećeg *predavača*.
questions.e: Predavač — a lecturer; predavanje — a lecture.

questions.q: Zato što je jako obimna i *glomazna* tema.
questions.e: Glomazan — bulky, voluminous.

questions.q: *Daktilografkinja* je sedela sakrivena u ćošku.
questions.e: Daktilografkinja — a typist.

questions.q: Niko živ nije *iznajmljivao* stanove.
questions.e: Iznajmljivati — to rent out or to rent.

questions.q: Vaš glavni *konkurent* ne mora da bude iz vaše oblasti.
questions.e: Konkurent — a competitor.

questions.q: Postoji *potražnja* na tržištu.
questions.e: Potražnja — demand; tražiti — to seek, to demand.

questions.q: Probajte da napravite nešto *opipljivo*.
questions.e: Opipljiv — tangible; pipati — to feel by touch.

questions.q: Krenuli smo u neku *kladionicu* na Novom Beogradu.
questions.e: Kladionica — a betting shop.

questions.q: Hvala ___ na pozivu.
questions.e: Hvala to whom — dative case: organizatorima.

questions.q: Milovan je vođa grupe za istraživanja ___.
questions.e: Research of what? Genitive plural: korisnika.

questions.q: idite da pričate sa svojim ___.
questions.e: Sa ("with") + instrumental plural: sa korisnicima — with users.

questions.q: Daktilografkinja je sedela sakrivena u ___.
questions.e: U in answer to "where?" — locative case: u ćošku.

questions.q: Tako što ___ i razvijate softver za voice recognition.
questions.e: A one-off action before an ongoing process is perfective: sednete ("sit down"). Sedate is imperfective.

questions.q: Ko je glavni konkurent ___?
questions.e: Konkurent to what/whom — dative case: konkurent Netfliksu.

questions.q: Ne morate da ulupate hiljade evra u brži ___.
questions.e: Ulupati u + accusative case; for inanimate nouns it coincides with the nominative: lift.

questions.q: Prototip aplikacije možete da napravite za pet do šest ___.
questions.e: After numbers from 5 the genitive plural is used: minuta.
